paper_budget.differences: LOOP source gives nominal 240 rollouts and early-stops stragglers at >=90%; our fixed owner collects all 240. Official training example sets learning_max_seq_len=32000, truncates each API output to 3000 tokens and ends an individual episode on MaxSeqLenExceeded; these do not guarantee that all episodes finish within the cap. Current owner retains full API observations; the user approved ending the affected episode at the reserved 32768 context budget, retaining only existing official rewards, without introducing the API-output truncation. No LOOP filters, reward normalization, trained value model or replacement PPO are added. Existing VERL official success reward 10/0 stays fixed; LOOP used test-pass fractions. The original max response 1500, LoRA rank16, LR5e-5 and minibatch32 are not substituted. Dev evaluation uses existing owner 40-turn loop, versus paper evaluation 50. One run, not three-seed aggregate. Author verl-agent defaults to history2 and10000 characters; this run uses existing history_length=40 and a default-inert character-cap option set to null to preserve the user-approved full-history contract.
